phase: Historical initial three-question authorization; superseded by summary-final.json
scope: Synthetic public questions only; no audio, meeting, chat or organization-data tools
transport: Official ACP stdio NDJSON, protocol version 1

limitations: Provider first text is not a measured WPF paint timestamp.
ACP exposes prompt submission, not the server's actual model-call-start timestamp.
These are three different synthetic questions, not a matched repeated p50/p95 study.
The historical 69.881-second Sonnet marker smoke used a different prompt and was not a paired baseline.
Cold initialization remains variable and can take tens of seconds; no guaranteed sub-five-second claim.
The app does not request retries; opaque upstream retry attempts are not observable through ACP.

quality.firstTwoAnswers: Direct algorithm explanations, C# implementations and O(n) time/space; no workspace exploration or tool commands
quality.generatedCSharp: Both actual returned implementations compiled; 12 checks passed across standard, duplicate, negative, zero and no-pair cases
quality.ambiguousQuestion: Asked for the missing problem statement rather than inventing a Two Sum correction
quality.ambiguousInputProvenance: Original synthetic variation, not claimed to be an exact copy of the owner's reported bad ASR sentence

zeroToolEvidence.explanation: Pinned engine's actual offline POSTs confirmed empty tool lists and isolated fresh sessions. ACP does not expose the one-shot JSON usage_checkpoint; live tool/client requests are rejected, not permitted.

safety.questionFormat: Fixed direct-answer policy plus one JSON userQuestion field preserving ExactText; @ escaped as JSON data
safety.profile: Fresh owned HOME/USERPROFILE/COPILOT_HOME/work, no MCPs/plugins/custom instructions, fixed safety settings, no conversation resume/load
safety.retention: Agency/Copilot may retain their own session artifacts inside the isolated engine directory until Stop/Dispose/rotation. Every conversation is closed and never reused. At most 32 conversations per owned engine; all owned files removed on shutdown, cancellation or failure.
safety.authLimit: Authentication notices stop the owned process; this is not a universal guarantee that an external wrapper can never display expired-auth UI.

coverage: Exact envelope and invalid Unicode rejection
Fresh session IDs and no prior user-message history
Strict terminal end_turn plus acknowledged session/close
Tool, permission, plan and stale-session rejection
Explicit model/reasoning/permission confirmation before question submission
Cancellation, timeout, warmup-stop, iterator abandonment and cleanup
Version-cache invalidation and bounded engine rotation
validation.regressionFoundAndFixed: No-prompt production validation found Agency's cosmetic companyAnnouncements field. Semantic settings validation now preserves every safety field while permitting only a bounded display-only announcement array; actual repeated warmup passed afterward.

parentIntegrationRequired: Retain one AgencyCliAnswerProvider instance for the current AnswerSettings instead of constructing it for every Ask.
Call public WarmUpAsync(CancellationToken) when the explicit Agency configuration is loaded or revealed. It prepares only the transport, never an inferred question.
Continue passing the unchanged AnswerRequest(RequestId, ExactText) to StreamAsync. No common contract change is required.
Call public StopAsync() after cancelling the active run on Hide, Clear and protection failure. Await cleanup before starting another run.
Call DisposeAsync() on provider replacement, configuration reload and window/application close.
Show preparing/ready states without blocking typing. An Ask during warmup waits on the same owned provider gate.

Diagnostics use ProviderLaunch, ProviderVersion, ProviderReady, ModelStarted code acp_prompt_submitted, FirstAnswerText code provider_delta, AnswerCompleted and RequestCleanup. Keep the app-visible timestamp distinct, e.g. code ui_visible.
Default Agency model is now explicitly gpt-5.4-mini with low effort; an explicitly configured different model must still confirm low effort and restricted permissions. No silent fallback.
